description: Send the person's answer to a live call's pending_question, or decline. Send only what they said; answered once.

answer.description: The person's answer, in their words (required unless decline is true)

call_id.description: The KaiCalls call ID from make_call

decline.description: True when the person does not want to share this (optional)

question_id.description: The pending_question.question_id to answer (optional; defaults to the oldest open question)

name: answer_call_question
title: Answer Call Question
